about: Owner and principal designer of Brackwater Studio, a three-person residential and small-commercial interior architecture studio; also uses a personal mailbox for family and friends.

messages.subject: Marks on the new kitchen floor
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

We are loving the kitchen, truly. One thing though: after I mopped the floor on Sunday (with the soap the installer left us) there are these cloudy white patches on the Hearth Oak, mostly near the sink and the island. They don't wipe off. Is that normal for a matte finish or did I do something wrong?

Thanks,
Claire

messages.subject: Re: Marks on the new kitchen floor
messages.body:
Hi Claire,

You definitely didn't do anything wrong, that soap is what we recommend. Could you send me a few photos in daylight? I'll come by Thursday afternoon to take a look in person.

Best,
Ines

messages.subject: Re: Marks on the new kitchen floor
messages.body:
Photos attached, sorry for the delay. You can see the haze best in the third one by the dishwasher. Thanks for coming by Thursday, it was good to see you. Let me know what the flooring people say.

Claire

messages.subject: Hazy spots on the loft floor
messages.body:
Hey Ines, hope you're well. Quick one: the Hearth Oak boards in the main room have developed whitish blotches, mostly where we mop. We used the cleaner from the care sheet, nothing else. It looks a bit like water rings on a table. The rest of the loft is perfect so I hate to complain, but it's the first thing you see when you walk in. Any idea?

Dev

messages.subject: Re: Sample boards for Linden Court
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

Sample boards for the two Linden Court units go out Monday, three finishes each.

Separate heads-up while I have you: we found that Hearth Oak matte from production lots 2207 and 2208 (shipped September and October) has a finish curing problem. On some floors it shows as a white haze after wet cleaning. We cover a free re-oil by our own technician, but the claim needs the lot numbers and photos and has to be filed by December 15. If any of your clients see it, send them our way.

Dana Whitcomb
Timberline Floors, trade accounts

messages.subject: Sample boards for Linden Court
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Could you send sample boards for two apartments at Linden Court? Light and mid tones, matte and satin. Same shipping address as usual.

Thanks!
Ines

messages.subject: Re: Alternative to a brass dome pendant
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the call. Our Wren pendant is the closest match: 12 in spun brass dome, same cord length options, dimmable. Trade price $395 each for orders of 6 or more, lead time about 3 weeks. Spec sheet attached. Happy to send a sample if you want to see the finish next to the other one.

Cheers,
Jonah Reyes
Coppice Lighting

messages.subject: Lighting plan - yes!
messages.body:
Ines!! The lighting plan is perfect. Go ahead and order the 8 Arden pendants over the long counter, same as the ones in your mockup. Budget is tight after the espresso machine, so if anything changes price-wise just tell me.

Bea

messages.subject: Re: Lighting plan - yes!
messages.body:
So glad you like it! I'll place the pendant order this week and send you the delivery date once I have it.

Ines

messages.subject: Linden Court 4B - the wall
messages.body:
Dear Ines,

We have decided: the wall between the kitchen and the living room goes. The building board told us they need a letter from a structural engineer before they approve anything, and they asked whether the original structural drawings of the building are available. I have no idea where to get those. Can you take care of this part?

Warmly,
Marguerite Osei
Unit 4B, Linden Court

messages.subject: Re: Linden Court 4B - the wall
messages.body:
Dear Marguerite,

Great news, it will make a big difference. Yes, I'll handle the engineer and the drawings and come back to you with costs before we commit to anything.

Best,
Ines

messages.subject: 6A hallway wall
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on our walkthrough: we'd like to open up the wall between the hallway and the kitchen after all. The board at Linden Court says we need a structural engineer's letter plus the original building drawings before they'll even look at it. Can you add that to your scope? Let me know what it costs.

Thanks,
Tomas
6A

messages.subject: Re: Freight elevator for 4B
messages.body:
Hello Ines,

The freight elevator is yours on December 3 from 9 to 1, pads will be up.

To your other question: we do not have the original structural drawings on file. The city records archive can retrieve them, it is $350 per request and takes two to three weeks. For what it's worth, the units in the 4 and 6 lines sit on the same bearing walls, so one set of drawings covers that whole stack.

Regards,
Harriet Coyle
Linden Court Management

messages.subject: Freight elevator for 4B
messages.body:
Hi Harriet,

Could we book the freight elevator for a delivery to 4B in early December? Also, do you happen to have the building's original structural drawings? The board is asking for them.

Thank you,
Ines Halloran
Brackwater Studio

messages.subject: Re: Wall removal letter, Linden Court
messages.body:
Ines,

Happy to help. My fee is $600 per site visit plus $400 per letter. I would need the original structural drawings before the visit, otherwise I have to open up the ceiling to check. I'll send you my available dates next week.

Sam Adeyemi, PE
Adeyemi Engineering

messages.subject: it's loud in here
messages.body:
Hi Ines, three weeks open and people love the space. The one complaint we keep getting is the noise at lunch, with the concrete floor and all the glass you can't hear the person across from you. Two regulars told me they go elsewhere for meetings now. Do you know anyone who does acoustic stuff? Panels, ceiling, whatever helps.

xx Bea

messages.subject: Nice meeting you at design night
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

It was great to chat at Thursday's design night, and thanks for the tip about the bookshop on Wharf Lane. As I mentioned, I'm an acoustic consultant and I'm trying to do more small hospitality work: cafés, restaurants, wine bars. If you ever come across a client with a noise problem, I'd really appreciate an introduction. I do a free first visit.

Best,
Ravi Menon
Menon Acoustics

messages.subject: Re: Nice meeting you at design night
messages.body:
Hi Ravi, likewise! I'll keep you in mind, a lot of our hospitality clients end up with hard surfaces everywhere. Enjoy the bookshop.

Ines

messages.subject: Your stay at Larch cabin, Dec 18-21
messages.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for booking with us! You're in Larch cabin from Friday December 18 to Monday December 21, three nights, sleeps four. The wood stove will be stocked. The balance of $280 is due by December 1.

See you in the snow,
Hollis
Pinecrest Cabins

messages.subject: Re: Your stay at Larch cabin, Dec 18-21
messages.body:
Hi Ines, just a friendly note since a few guests asked: you can change your dates for free until December 4. After that we keep 50% if dates change. Larch is still open the weekend before and after, if that ever helps.

Hollis

messages.subject: Mom's 70th!!
messages.body:
Ines! It's decided: Mom's 70th birthday dinner is at our place on Sunday December 20, 6 pm. Everyone is coming, even Uncle Pat. She thinks it's just a small lunch so don't say a word. Can you do dessert? The lemon cake she loves would be perfect.

Love, Lena

messages.subject: Re: Mom's 70th!!
messages.body:
Oh she's going to cry. Yes, I'll bring the lemon cake! Lips sealed.

x

messages.subject: flights booked
messages.body:
Hey sis, flights are booked. I land at Harborview on December 22 at 2:10 pm, terminal B. Any chance someone can grab me? Not a big deal if not, I can take the train.

F

messages.subject: Christmas arrival
messages.body:
Hi Ines!

I finally booked my flight for Christmas. I land at Harborview on December 22 at 3:05 pm, terminal B. Would you or someone be able to pick me up? I don't want to bother your mom with the airport traffic. If it's a hassle I'll get a cab, really.

Hugs,
Mae

messages.subject: Re: flights booked
messages.body: Yay! I'll figure out the pickup and let you know. Don't take the train with all your bags.

messages.subject: Quote for a new front counter
messages.body:
Hello Ines,

A friend recommended you. I run Brooks Bakery on Mill Street and I want to replace our front counter: it's too low, the glass case is cracked and there's nowhere to put the register. Would you be able to give me a rough quote for designing a new counter? I can send measurements.

Thank you,
Nadia Brooks

messages.subject: Returning the counter stool sample
messages.body:
Hi Ines, thanks for lending us the counter stool sample. We've decided against stools for the kitchen island after all, so I'd like to send it back. What address should I ship it to, the studio or the showroom?

Nadia

Gil

Ines

I'd love to come and stay with you and Theo for a few days sometime this winter, whenever it suits you. No rush, you're busy. I can help with school pickups.

messages.subject: Eiken tafel voor de wachtkamer
messages.body:
Hallo Ines,

Dank je voor de tekening van de tafel. Ik kan hem maken van massief eiken, met een geoliede afwerking. De prijs is 2.450 euro, inclusief verzending naar jullie studio. Wil je de poten recht of licht schuin? Laat het me weten, dan zet ik hem in de planning.

Groetjes,
Joost Brouwer
Meubelmakerij Brouwer

Dank je wel! De poten graag licht schuin, zoals op de schets. De prijs is prima voor ons. Kun je me ook een datum voor de levering geven?

Groetjes,
Ines

messages.subject: Re: Eiken tafel voor de wachtkamer

Hoi Ines,

De tafel staat in de planning. Hij is klaar in week 50 en ik stuur hem dan meteen op. Ik maak ook een paar foto's voor je portfolio, als je dat wilt.

Groeten,
Joost

Top, dank je! Foto's zijn heel welkom. Tot snel.

Ines

messages.subject: Einladung: offene Werkstatt im Januar

Liebe Ines,

wir laden Sie herzlich zu unserer offenen Werkstatt am 16. Januar ein. Wir zeigen die neuen Leuchten aus Messing und Glas, und es gibt auch eine kleine Führung durch die Produktion. Bitte geben Sie uns bis Ende Dezember Bescheid, ob Sie kommen möchten.

Werkstatt Falkenrath

Viele Grüße
Ines Halloran

messages.subject: Re: Einladung: offene Werkstatt im Januar

Liebe Ines,

das freut uns sehr! Für Gäste aus dem Ausland haben wir auch Zimmer in einer Pension in der Nähe reserviert. Sagen Sie einfach Bescheid, wenn Sie eins brauchen.

Herzliche Grüße
Katrin

messages.subject: Fotos vom Sommer
messages.body:
Hallo Ines,

ich habe endlich die Fotos von unserem Wochenende am See sortiert! Theo auf dem Boot ist mein Lieblingsbild. Ich schicke dir den Link, sobald alles hochgeladen ist. Wie geht es dir und dem Studio?

Liebe Grüße
Annika

messages.subject: Re: Fotos vom Sommer
messages.body:
Liebe Annika,

oh wie schön, danke! Mir geht es gut, das Studio hat gerade sehr viel Arbeit, aber ich kann nicht klagen. Ich freue mich auf die Fotos und auf den nächsten Sommer mit euch.

Liebe Grüße
Ines

messages.subject: Échantillons de lin
messages.body:
Bonjour Ines,

Merci pour votre demande. Je vous envoie cette semaine les échantillons de lin lavé pour les rideaux, en six teintes. Le délai pour une commande est de quatre semaines. Est-ce que vous avez besoin aussi des échantillons de velours ?

Cordialement,
Sylvie Beaulieu
Atelier Beaulieu

messages.subject: Re: Échantillons de lin
messages.body:
Bonjour Sylvie,

Merci beaucoup ! Oui, avec plaisir pour le velours aussi, surtout les tons verts et bruns. Je vous écris dès que le client a choisi.

Cordialement,
Ines Halloran

messages.subject: Re: Échantillons de lin
messages.body:
Bonjour Ines,

Je me permets de revenir vers vous : est-ce que le client a choisi une teinte ? Nos prix pour le lin augmentent le premier janvier, donc une commande avant la fin de l'année serait plus avantageuse pour vous.

Bien à vous,
Sylvie

messages.subject: Un petit café ?
messages.body:
Coucou Ines !

Je suis en ville la semaine prochaine pour le travail. Tu as le temps pour un café mercredi ou jeudi ? Je veux aussi voir des photos de la cuisine dont tu m'as parlé.

Bises,
Mathilde

messages.subject: Re: Un petit café ?
messages.body: Coucou Mathilde ! Avec plaisir, jeudi matin pour moi c'est parfait. Je te montre les photos, promis. Bises, Ines

messages.subject: Azulejos para el baño
messages.body:
Hola Ines,

Gracias por tu correo. Tenemos el azulejo verde de 10 x 10 en stock, unos 40 metros cuadrados. El precio es de 38 euros por metro cuadrado, y el envío tarda unas tres semanas. ¿Quieres que te reserve una cantidad?

Saludos,
Diego Olmedo
Cerámica Olmedo

messages.subject: Re: Azulejos para el baño
messages.body:
Hola Diego,

Muchas gracias. Sí, por favor, reserva 12 metros cuadrados para el proyecto. Te confirmo el pedido final cuando el cliente vea la muestra.

Saludos,
Ines

messages.subject: Re: Azulejos para el baño
messages.body:
Hola Ines,

La reserva de los 12 metros cuadrados vence el 5 de diciembre. Después de esa fecha no te puedo garantizar el mismo lote. ¿Ya tienes la respuesta del cliente?

Un saludo,
Diego

messages.subject: ¡La receta!
messages.body:
Hola Ines,

Aquí tienes la receta de la tarta de almendras que te gustó tanto. Es muy fácil, pero no te olvides de tostar las almendras antes. ¡Cuéntame cómo te sale!

Un abrazo,
Lucía

messages.subject: Re: ¡La receta!
messages.body: ¡Muchas gracias, Lucía! La hago este fin de semana con Theo. Te mando una foto. Un abrazo muy fuerte.

messages.body: Hi parents, starting next week practice moves to the indoor sports center on Elm, same time Tuesdays and Thursdays. Bring indoor shoes please. Coach Reggie

messages.subject: Your order has shipped
messages.body: Good news! Your order #55120 (kids' winter boots, size 3) has shipped and will arrive Thursday.

messages.subject: New this week
messages.body: Three new holiday movies and the final season you've been waiting for. Start watching now.

messages.subject: old house photos
messages.body: Hi kiddo, I scanned the photos of the old house on Birch Road like you asked. Some of the kitchen before we redid it, you'll laugh at the wallpaper. They're in the shared folder. Dad

messages.subject: Re: old house photos
messages.body: Dad these are amazing, that orange wallpaper! Thank you for doing this. Theo can't believe I was that small.

messages.subject: Your hold is ready
messages.body: The item you placed on hold is ready for pickup at the Central branch. It will be held for 7 days.

messages.subject: Your November statement
messages.body: Your statement is ready. Amount due: $142.18, due December 8. Autopay is on.

messages.subject: happy birthday!!
messages.body: Happy birthday big sister! Hope Theo spoils you. Present is in the mail, it's late as usual. F

messages.subject: Re: happy birthday!!
messages.body: Thank you! Theo made pancakes, mostly on the floor. Can't wait to see you at Christmas.

messages.subject: Your car is ready
messages.body: Hi Ines, the car is ready. New brake pads in front and the winter tires are on. Total $486. We're open till 6. Rafe

messages.subject: your package
messages.body: Hi! I took in a big box for you this afternoon, it was getting rained on. Come grab it whenever. Gwen

messages.subject: Re: your package
messages.body: You're the best, thank you! I'll come by tonight.

messages.subject: the cranberry thing
messages.body: Here's the cranberry relish recipe you asked for. Use the orange zest, don't skip it. Love, Mom

messages.subject: book club at mine
messages.body: Book club is at my place on the 12th! We're doing the lighthouse novel. Can you bring a salad? Odile

messages.subject: Re: book club at mine
messages.body: Salad it is. I'm only halfway through the book, no spoilers please!

messages.subject: Fall sale: fares from $79
messages.body: Fly somewhere warm this winter. Fares from $79 one way, book by Sunday.

messages.subject: DesignStack weekly: the year in kitchens
messages.body: Our editors pick the kitchens of the year, plus a guide to holiday lead times from 40 suppliers.

messages.subject: Shelving phase 2
messages.body: Hi Ines, we're happy with the shelving and want to talk about doing the same in the conference room. Could we meet Tuesday morning at our office? Victor

messages.subject: Re: Shelving phase 2
messages.body: Great to hear! Tuesday at 9:30 works. I'll bring the drawings from phase 1. Ines

messages.subject: Theo's sweater
messages.body: I finished Theo's sweater, the blue one. I'll post it on Monday. Tell him it's a little big on purpose. Love, Mom

messages.subject: Floor delivery
messages.body: Hi Ines, the flooring arrived this morning, lots of boxes in the garage! The installers start Monday as planned. Claire

opportunities.what: Hartwell and Okafor both report white haze on Hearth Oak floors installed in Sept/Oct; Timberline says lots 2207/2208 have a curing defect with a free re-oil if claimed by Dec 15. File one claim with lot numbers and photos for both floors and tell both clients the fix.

Lumenhall raised the Arden pendant from $410 to $468, Coppice quoted a matching Wren pendant at $395, and the 8-pendant Ferreira café order is still unplaced. Before ordering, switch to Coppice or ask Lumenhall to match (about $580 saved) and tell Bea.

Osei 4B and Lindqvist 6A both need the original structural drawings and an engineer letter; the manager says one $350 archive set covers both units. Order the drawings once and book Sam for one visit covering both units.
Bea's café is losing lunch regulars to noise and she asked for an acoustic expert; Ravi Menon, met at design night, wants café work and offers a free first visit. Introduce Bea to Ravi.
The Larch cabin is booked Dec 18-21, but Mom's surprise 70th dinner is Sunday Dec 20. Dates change free only until Dec 4: move the cabin to an open weekend now.
Felix lands at Harborview terminal B on Dec 22 at 2:10 pm and Mae at 3:05 pm the same day and terminal. Plan one airport pickup for both and tell them.

traps.what: Two people share the first name Nadia and both mention a counter: a bakery counter quote and a stool sample return. Different people, unrelated requests.
Juniper is a backordered paint color for the Pruitt job and also the street of Gil's new house; the shared word links nothing.
A work client and a personal neighbor both want a deck builder; combining would join work and personal mail.
Coordinating June's attendance at the Pruitt inspection is moot: it happened on Oct 6, over 30 days ago, and passed with June there.
Two clients complained about late upholstery, but Wes later delivered both and Priya confirmed.
Mom and Aunt Clare both want to visit sometime this winter, but there is no date in either; a joint visit plan would invent dates. Each just needs a reply asking when.
Leah and Victor both want 2026 invoice copies; an open to-do already covers sending both.
The two pantry hinge reports are Gordon Pike writing from his office and personal addresses.
Walnut price rises appear only in a trade newsletter and a supplier notice; no client or order is affected.
